services.name: Shelf Rental
services.desc: Enjoy the flexibility of coming in and working on your own schedule. You are assigned a key and have access 24/7 except when group ceramics classes are happening. Tools and wheels are here to enjoy. You need only purchase your clay and glazes. If you need some inspiration or help troubleshooting, you have the option of having instruction for an additional fee. Bring in your ideas and get busy creating your masterpieces! Shawn Vincent is RAC’s Ceramics Program Director. She can be reached at svincent(at)riversideartscenter.comChristine Blanek is RAC’s Ceramics Studio Director and can be reached at cblanek(at)riversideartscenter.com Closed Sunday - Tuesday, Holidays, and between exhibitions.

blurb: The Riverside Arts Center is a regional anchor for creative practice and learning. Home to galleries, artist studios, and a school that showcases the art of our time, RAC serves as a hub for artistic exploration and community engagement. Since 1993, the Riverside Arts Center (RAC) has been providing Riverside, its surrounding suburbs and the city of Chicago with vital arts programming.
